mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals labor market deterioration and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle contraction regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle contraction periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units, it signals contraction in the housing sector and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1500.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both PAYEMS and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL YoY > 6.0%), aggressive monetary tightening reduces corporate profit margins and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
